@ the arm of a match~ that ^k chooses reads the event where it is written, and a ^t in it the end of the stage
render event_saved_deferred_values.match_arm sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[0 1 0 2 3 0 0 4 5]
render event_saved_deferred_values.match_arm_let sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[0 1 0 2 3 0 0 4 5]
render event_saved_deferred_values.match_arm_end sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[0 1 0 2 3 0 0 4 5]
@ the branch of an if~ that ^k chooses reads the event where it is written, and a ^t in it the end of the stage
@ the condition of an if with ^k and the branch both read the event where it is written
@ the guard after a guard with ^k and its arm read the event where it is written
@ the right side of && with ^k on the left reads the event where it is written, and a ^t there the end of the stage
render event_saved_deferred_values.and_right sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[1 0 1 1 0 1 1 0 0]
render event_saved_deferred_values.and_right_let sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[1 0 1 1 0 1 1 0 0]
render event_saved_deferred_values.and_right_end sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9] y=[1 0 1 1 0 1 1 0 0]
@ the later condition of an if~ chain, chosen by ^k in the first, reads the event where it is written
@ a part computed at the clock of the event, in the branch that ^h of init chooses, is the value before the event of the sample
render event_saved_deferred_values.init_branch sr=0x41000000 cfg n=1 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_deferred_values.init_branch_let sr=0x41000000 cfg n=1 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_deferred_values.init_branch_end sr=0x41000000 cfg n=1 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_deferred_values.init_branch sr=0x41000000 cfg n=0 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
@ a part of sample / 4 that reads ^m is made at the end of its tick and reads the event where it is written
render event_saved_deferred_values.slow_part sr=0x41000000 params k=2 frames=16
render event_saved_deferred_values.slow_part_let sr=0x41000000 params k=2 frames=16
render event_saved_deferred_values.slow_part_end sr=0x41000000 params k=2 frames=16
